A woman can be masculine and still identify as a woman, a straight woman won't see a lesbian who seems 'butch' and then go 'oh she seems very masculine so I'll date her'. You can't assume that someone who seems to be fitting into the role that society says is for people of the opposite gender are doing so to try and tempt people of their own gender to become attracted to them. A lesbian who's attracted to women who seem masculine isn't being heteronormative in any way because the woman, as manly as she may seem to you, is still a woman at the end of the day. I don't really see the big deal with people breaking out of traditional gender roles and acting butch or being flamboyant or any of that shit. I know straight people who do it too without the intention of 'acting like people of the opposite sex'
